state.option_roles: Expose/import the existing customer_reader role and use [salesperson,customer_reader] for the five salesperson rows in both original tables. Keep members negative row, all seeds/model data/guards/order/expected values and errors unchanged. Production policy grants remain unchanged. This represents a staff sales operator with explicit limited directory-read role; costs one export/import plus repeated two-role cell arrays, which use an existing primitive.
state.option_admin_seed: Import existing test_admin fixture and seed it alongside test_worker in both tables, keeping all caller cells salesperson/members and all assertions. Production grants remain unchanged. This represents a salesperson who also has administrator rights on the example company through company-owned data, rather than the limited staff reader role. Fewer caller tokens and no public role export; it tests a stronger customer relationship and adds a model fixture dependency.
state.same_acceptance: Both must run all six original expectations through same runtime and still deny missing operation role; preserve rollback/replay/current authority and exact first-failure order.
